profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer | React · TypeScript · Go · AWS | Agentic AI · LLM Evaluation · Workflow Automation
profile.summary: I’m a software engineer who enjoys building things that work well and feel good to use. I’ve built web and mobile apps using React, Vue, React Native, Go, and Postgres. Basically, everything from clean front-end interfaces to solid backend APIs. I like solving real problems, learning new tools, and making products that people actually find useful.  Let's connect!

positions.title: Co-Founder / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-founder and software engineer at Liminal Drip, a software studio focused on building intelligent systems.

Currently contributing to Yunto, a scheduling product for dates and meetings. My work includes building agentic scheduling flows, improving core UI experiences, and adding PostHog analytics to better understand user behavior and support product iteration.

I work across product direction, frontend engineering, AI-assisted workflows, and launch planning, with a focus on turning early product ideas into usable software.


- Built agentic scheduling flows to support date planning, meeting coordination, and rescheduling logic.
- Contributed to UI redesign work across core scheduling experiences.
- Added PostHog analytics to track user behavior and support product iteration.
- Worked across product direction, engineering, and launch planning for Yunto.
positions.insights: Skills: Agentic AI Development · LLM Workflows · React Native · TypeScript · Product Analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Built and maintained front-end applications using Vue 2 and React (TypeScript), implementing Vuex, TanStack Query, React Router, and Vite to deliver performant, maintainable interfaces. 

• Refactored legacy Vue components into modular, reusable structures, improving scalability, developer productivity, and maintainability. 

• Collaborated with Go backend engineers and contributed minor updates to shared services, assisting with API integration, data validation, and system debugging across environments. 

• Modified and maintained GitHub Actions and CircleCI workflows to streamline CI/CD pipelines and improve build reliability. 

• Diagnosed and resolved issues within AWS CloudFormation, S3, and CloudWatch, improving deployment stability and observability. 

• Utilized Datadog for end-to-end debugging, performance tracing, and alerting across multiple environments.

• Created and maintained Cypress E2E tests, reducing regression risk and increasing release confidence. 

• Coordinated bi-weekly front-end guild syns to standardize patterns and improve cross-team collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Vue.js · React.js · Golang · Front-End Development · Vite · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cypress.io · CircleCI · SQL · TypeScript

Live app: https://rolenext.app

projects.title: Symlinkit
projects.description:
Symlinkit is a command-line tool for managing symbolic links across Linux, macOS, and WSL. It enhances ln -s with CRUD-like features create, read (inspect), update, and delete—while keeping the process safe and repeatable. It automates linking dotfiles, config directories, and project paths without touching the originals. The focus is safety, clarity, and reproducibility.

Core behavior: it links files from a defined source directory into system locations, verifies integrity, and prevents accidental overwrites. It can run interactively or headless through manifest files.

Core features:
- Cross-platform operation (Linux, macOS, WSL)
- CRUD-style symlink management (create, inspect, update, remove)
- Strict safety checks before linking or deleting
- Dry-run previews for every operation
- Detects and repairs broken or stale links
- Manifest-driven setup for consistent environments
- Color-coded output and simple logging

Version 3 is being rewritten in Go. The rewrite replaces the Bash scripts with a modular Go codebase, stronger test coverage, structured error handling, and improved performance.

Symlinkit makes ln -s practical for large environments by turning it into a predictable, auditable, and automated process.

Project link: https://github.com/ctrl-alt-adrian/symlinkit
